Name: Pinch Hitter
Short Description: If all of your other pokemon have fainted, this pokemon transforms.
Extended description: If this Pokemon is the last Pokemon on your team who does not have the fainted status, then it transforms.

Name: Quick Protector
Short Description: Protective status moves become extremely fast.
Extended description: Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, and Lucky Chant have +5 priority.

Name: Resonate
Short Description: Cancel and counter sound-based moves.
Extended description: Any sound-based move not used by this pokemon is prevented, then this creature reflects 25% of the damage that would have been dealt from that move back towards the user of that move as typeless sound-based damage.

Name: Amplifier
Short Description: Sound-based moves deal a bonus damage.
Extended description: Sound based moves deal x1.5 damage.

Name: Smoocher
Short Description: Kiss-based moves deal double damage.
Extended description: Moves with 'kiss' in their title or that imply kissing deal double damage.

Name: Dizzying Step
Short Description: When confused, gains bonus physical damage
Extended description: While confused the user deals an additional x1.5 damage with physical moves and are less likely to hurt themselves in confusion.

Name: Rivalry
Short Description: If this pokemon sees its rival, it readies itself for a fight.
Extended description: If this creature's rival pokemon is on the field when it enters or when its rival pokemon enters the field for the first time, its Defense stage, Special Defense stage, and Speed stage all increase by 1. This effect can trigger once, resetting only if this pokemon is swapped out.

Name: Massive Stinger
Short Description: Powers up Bug-Type moves and increases their critical hit chance.
Extended description: Bug type moves deal x1.5 damage and their critical hit chance is doubled.

Name: Night Operative
Short Description: This pokemon will always wake up when it is needed.
Extended description: If a move other than snore or sleep talk is selected while this pokemon is asleep, it will always wake up to use that move.

Name: Critical Parry
Short Description: Counters OHKO from a critical hit.
Extended description: If this creature is at full health and would be fainted by a damage dealing critical hit, it hangs on with 1 HP then immediately activates the move Counter. Multihit moves are interrupted. (continue if not dead? let the engine decide)

Name: Berrymade
Short Description: Berries are more effective and are used earlier.
Extended description: Ripen + Gluttony

Name: Hyper Cutter
Short Description: Prevents Attack reduction and boosts pincer moves.
Extended description: Prevents other pokemon from lowering the Attack stage of this pokemon. Additionally, moves that are pincer-based (metal claw, crunch, crabhammer, and vice grip) deal x1.3 damage.

Name: Stench
Short Description: Attacks may cause flinch and all berries are less effective.
Extended description: Attacks have a 10% chance to flinch and any berries consumed while this pokemon is on the field have their effect reduced by 50%. Poison types are immune to this ability.

Name: Iron Fist
Short Description: Punching moves are boosted and are unaffected by Reflect.
Extended description: Punching moves deal x1.2 damage and are not reduced in damage by Reflect.

Name: Hydration
Short Description: Heals Pokemon and cures status condition in the rain.
Extended description: During rain, this Pokemon will heal 1/16th of its health back at the end of each turn, and will then have a 50% chance of curing any status conditions.

Name: Leaf Guard
Short Description: Prevents status condition and lowering status while in sunlight.
Extended description: During sunlight, this Pokemon cannot recieve a status condition or have any of its stat stages lowered.

Name: Ice Body
Short Description: The Pokemon will restore it's health while it is snowing.
Extended description: During snow or hail, this Pokemon regains 1/8th of it's health at the end of each turn. This also prevents damage from hail if a Pokemon would otherwise be hurt by it.

Name: Heavy Metal
Short Description: Doubles a Pokemon's weight and somewhat increases defense.
Extended description: Double a Pokemon's weight. It gains a x1.3 increase to its Defense.

Name: Light Metal
Short Description: Halves a Pokemon's weight and slightly increases speed.
Extended description: Halve a Pokemon's weight. It's Speed stats gain a x1.1 increase.

Name: Immunity
Short Description: The Pokemon cannot be Poisoned or Paralyzed.

Name: Clear Body
Short Description: Cannot be Poisoned and stats cannot be lowered.

Name: Illuminate
Short Description: Accuracy cannot be lowered, and on swap in resets evasion.
Extended description: This Pokemon's accuracy cannot be lowered, and when it swaps in all Pokemon on the field have their Evasion stage set to 0.

Name: Early Bird
Short Description: Awakens quickly from sleep, gaining a speed boost when doing so.
Extended description: This Pokemon takes half the number of turns to wake up from the Sleep status. When this Pokemon awakens, it gains an increase to its Speed stage.

Name: Great Harvest
Short Description: May create another Berry for itself or an ally after one is used.
Extended description: If the Pokemon or its ally has used a Berry, there is a 50% chance of it being restored at the end of each turn.

Name: Magma Armor
Short Description: Lava-hot armor lets this Pokemon resist the cold.
Extended description: Prevents the frozen and frostbite status, prevents damage from hail, and halves damage from Ice-type moves.

Name: Overcoat
Short Description: Prevents from Burn, Frozen, Frostbite, and damage from weather.
Extended description: Prevents the burn, frozen, and frostbite status, and also stops any damage that might have been dealt to the Pokemon from any kind of weather.

Name: Magnet Pull
Short Description: Traps and grounds Steel-type Pokemon.
Extended description: Any Steel-type Pokemon on the field, including allies but excluding this Pokemon, are prevented from switching out and are forced to be grounded if they were not already so.

Name: Rain Dish
Short Description: Boosts Water-Type moves. If it is not raining, this will hurt the Pokemon.
Extended description: Water-type moves deal x1.2 damage, but those moves cost the user 10% of their health. However during rain, this penalty is removed.

Name: Hustle
Short Description: Boosts the Attack stat but causes inaccurate moves to always miss.
Extended description: The Pokemon gains a x1.3 boost to its Attack stat, but any move without 100% hit chance or '-' accuracy will always miss. This ability is affected by changes to this Pokemon's Accuracy, but is not affected by the opposing Pokemon's Evasion.

Name: Marvel Scale
Short Description: Ups defenses when afflicted, and removes afflictions after being hit.
Extended description: The Pokemon gains a x1.5 boost to Defense and Special Defense if it has a status condition. After being hit and dealt damage by a move used by another Pokemon, it removes any affliction it had.

Name: Mold Breaker
Short Description: Ignores the effects of most abilities when attacking.
Extended description: Mold Breaker + it also ignores contact abilities like Static.

Name: Jump In
Short Description: Does best when replacing a fainted Pokemon.
Extended description: If this Pokemon is selected to replace a Pokemon who fainted, it firstly inherets any positive stat stage boosts the fainted Pokemon had, then secondly its Speed is boosted by 1 stage.

Name: Toggle Mode
Short Description: At the end of every turn, swap Attack and Special Attack
Extended description: Attack and Special Attack are swapped at the end of every turn. This is not remembered when swapping out, so the first turn this Pokemon is on the field it will always have its original stats.

Name: Analytic
Short Description: Boosts power greatly if Pokemon moves last.
Extended description: If this pokemon executes its move after all other Pokemon have made their move, that move gains a x1.75 boost to its power.

Name: Corrupted
Short Description: Contact with this Pokemon may change other Pokemon's type.
Extended description: There is a 50% chance that any Pokemon that makes contact with this Pokemon will have one of it's non-Normal-types changed to Normal-type. If it is a Psychic-type, that chance becomes 100% and this will always change the Psychic-type to Normal-type if the target has more than one type.

Name: Bloom Spores
Short Description: When this Pokemon Blooms, it spreads to all creatures on the field.
Extended description: When this Pokemon gains the Blooming status, all other Pokemon on the field also gain the Blooming status.

Name: Petal Skating
Short Description: Speed is sharply raised when this Pokemon begins Blooming.
Extended description: When this Pokemon gains the Blooming status, its Speed is raised by 2 stages. If this Pokemon is not a Grass-type, its Speed is not reduced by Blooming and it is not prevented from swapping, but it does not regenerate health at the end of each turn.

Name: Budding
Short Description: This Pokemon gains and boosts the Grass-type when Blooming.
Extended description: When Blooming, this creature becomes a Grass-type, and Grass-type moves gain a x1.2 power boost.

Name: Keen Eye
Short Description: Prevents missing from Accuracy and Evasion and boosts critical chance.
Extended description: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered. It also ignores the target's stages in evasion. Additionally, critical hits are 50% more likely to occur.

Name: Frisk
Short Description: Reveals opponents items, and allows them to always be removed.
Extended description: The opponent's item will be revealed at the beginning of battle, and abilities and effects that would prevent that items removal (such as Sticky Hold) are disabled while this Pokemon is on the field.

Name: Flower Power
Short Description: Boosts and protects Special Attack while Blooming.
Extended description: The Pokemon gains a x1.3 boost to Special Attack while Blooming. Also while Blooming, Special Attack may not be lowered.  If this Pokemon is not a Grass-type, its Speed is not reduced by Blooming and it is not prevented from swapping, but it does not regenerate health at the end of each turn.

Name: Honey Gather
Short Description: Gathers honey after battle. Gives honey to allies if they need it.
Extended description: If this Pokemon's ally drops below 50%, it will feed it honey.

Name: Justified
Short Description: This Pokemon resists and is boosted by Dark-type attacks.
Extended description: The Pokemon takes half damage from Dark-type attacks, and additionally if it is hit by a Dark-type attack, its Attack is boosted by one stage.

Name: Big Pecks
Short Description: This Pokemon may use Defense in place of Attack. Defense is protected.
Extended description: When using physical attacks, if this Pokemon's Defense is higher than their Attack (including stat stage boosts) they use their Defense total instead of Attack total when calculating damage. Additionally, their Defense stat may not be lowered.

Name: Liquid Ooze
Short Description: Stops other Poison-type moves then heals from any wasted toxins.
Extended description: Any Poison-type move used by any Pokemon on the field other than this one has it's effects completely nullified, then this Pokemon will be healed by 1/8th of it's health.

Name: Plus
Short Description: If this Pokemon's Ally has Minus, this Pokemon gets bulky and floats.
Extended description: If the Pokemon's active partner in battle has the Minus or Superconduct ability, this Pokemon gets a x1.3 boost to Defense and Special Defense, and additionally levitates.

Name: Minus
Short Description: If this Pokemon's Ally has Plus, this Pokemon powers up and floats.
Extended description: If the Pokemon's active partner in battle has the Plus or Superconduct ability, this Pokemon gets a x1.5 boost to Attack and Special Attack, and additionally levitates.

Name: Superconduct
Short Description: This Pokemon is Plus and Minus, but only floats and gets a small boost.
Extended description: If this Pokemon's active partner in battle has the Plus, Minus, or Superconduct ability, this Pokemon gets a x1.1 boost to all stats except Health and Speed, and additionally levitates.

Name: Queen's Orders
Short Description: Ally order moves are repeated.
Extended description: If this Pokemon's partner uses 'Attack Order,' 'Defend Order,' or 'Heal Order,' this Pokemon uses that move too.

Name: Queenly Majesty
Extended description: Priorty moves used by enemies fail and this Pokemon is unflinchable.

Name: Silly Rascal
Short Description: Has a chance to cause a rucus.
Extended description: There is a 10% chance that, on any turn where a Pokemon with this ability is on the field, all Pokemon including this one will 'goof off' and refuse to do their usual moves. Damage over time and healing over time still apply, sleep still ticks down, and any multi-turn moves are interrupted.

Name: Monkey King
Short Description: Powers up Monkey Moves.
Extended description: The moves 'Monkey Around' and 'Monkey Business' have -1 priority. When this Pokemon uses any other move with the word 'Monkey' in it, they treat this Pokemon's 'monkey mindset' value as if it was one higher than it is.

Name: Skill Link
Short Description: Moves that can hit 5 times may hit more.
Extended description: Moves that may hit 2 to 5 times will hit an additional time.

Name: Anticipation
Short Description: Predicts moves
Extended description: Vanilla effects, but additionally if the first move a Pokemon uses against this Pokemon is the anticipated move, that move's damage is reduced by 1/2

Name: Cocooned
Short Description: Bulked up until first attack.
Extended description: When switching in this Pokemon gains a x1.5 Defense and Special Defense boost until it uses a non-status move.

Name: Heatproof
Short Description: Weakens FIRE-type moves.
Extended description: Fire-type moves used on this Pokemon have their damage reduced by 1/2 and this Pokemon is immune to the Burn status effect.

Name: Arsenal
Short Description: Stronger bullets.
Extended description: Bullet-type moves are stronger, and are unaffected by bulletproof.

Name: Unnerve
Short Description: Prevents berries and item-disabling.
Extended description: Opposing pokemon cannot use berries or the moves knock off, trick, or any other move that would affect this or allied pokemon's items
